function initMap() {
var start = {lat: 52.909547, lng: 18.803715};
map = new google.maps.Map(document.getElementById('map'), {
maxZoom: 12
});
latLngList = []
markerList = [];
infowindowList = [];
for (i = 0; i < markers1.markers.length; i++) {
var id = i;
var content = '<div id="content">'+
'<div id="title"><h3>'+ markers1.markers[i].name + '</h3></div>'+
'<div id="street">'+ markers1.markers[i].properties.street + '</div>'+
'<div id="postcode">'+ markers1.markers[i].properties.postcode + '</div>'+
'<div id="city">'+ markers1.markers[i].properties.city + '</div>'+
'<div id="district">'+ markers1.markers[i].properties.district + '</div>'+
'<div id="openHours">'+ markers1.markers[i].properties.openHours + '</div>'+
'<h5>Kontakt: </h5>'+
'<div id="phone">'+ markers1.markers[i].properties.phone + '</div>'+
'<div id="phone2">'+ markers1.markers[i].properties.phone2 + '</div>'+
'<div id="phone3">'+ markers1.markers[i].properties.phone3 + '</div>'+
'</div>';
var district = markers1.markers[i].properties.district;
var city = markers1.markers[i].properties.city;
var title = markers1.markers[i].name;
var pos = new google.maps.LatLng(markers1.markers[i].lat, markers1.markers[i].lng);
infowindowList[i] = new google.maps.InfoWindow({
content: content
});
markerList[i] = new google.maps.Marker({
position: pos,
map: map,
district: district,
city: city,
title: title,
id: id
});
markerList[i].addListener('click', createInfo(markerList[i].id));
latLngList.push(new google.maps.LatLng (markers1.markers[i].lat,markers1.markers[i].lng));
}
latlngbounds = new google.maps.LatLngBounds();
latLngList.forEach(function(latLng){
latlngbounds.extend(latLng);
});
map.setCenter(latlngbounds.getCenter());
map.fitBounds(latlngbounds);
if (paramDistrict != "" || paramCity != "") {
latLngList = [];
latlngbounds = new google.maps.LatLngBounds();
for (i = 0; i < markers1.markers.length; i++) {
if ((markers1.markers[i].properties.city == paramCity) || markers1.markers[i].properties.district == paramDistrict) {
latLngList.push(new google.maps.LatLng (markers1.markers[i].lat,markers1.markers[i].lng));
}
}
latLngList.forEach(function(latLng){
latlngbounds.extend(latLng);
});
map.setCenter(latlngbounds.getCenter());
map.fitBounds(latlngbounds);
}
}
var createInfo = function(id) {
return function() {
infowindowList[id].open(map, markerList[id]);
}
}
</script>
